editor.title: onlyoffice.1
editor.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Document editor]

global_param.name: KAILO_DOCUMENT_BINDING
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Kailo document binding projection]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Controlled bindingId/generation, Resource/version, native workspace/root and platform origin metadata. Set it to switch to governed editing: no native document token is issued then. Empty keeps native editing; this does not grant access.]

global_param.name: ONLYOFFICE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Document editor origin]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Public origin of the document editor instance (its wopi.host); discovery is read there]

global_param.name: ONLYOFFICE_WOPI_SOURCE_ORIGIN
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[WOPI source origin]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Cells origin used in wopisrc, the only origin the document editor may request]

global_param.name: ONLYOFFICE_EXTENSIONS
global_param.label: CONF_MESSAGE[Enabled extensions]
global_param.description: CONF_MESSAGE[Comma separated extensions opened with the document editor]
